description: This file contains Pydantic models representing various data schemas and API response structures related to the VoltSurge APIs within the project. The models define data structures for session info, health status, dataset statuses, column schemas, and CSV upload previews.

classes.name: SessionInfo
classes.description: Model representing session identification and timestamps.

classes.name: DatasetStatusResponse
classes.description: Model representing the high-level status of dataset payload for a session.

classes.name: ColumnSchema
classes.description: Model representing per-column schema information derived from data preview.

classes.name: CsvUploadPreviewResponse
classes.description: Model representing the response after uploading a CSV file, including schema and preview data.
